about_the_game:
Park the car!

Valet parking in parking garages is not an easy job. You have to park the cars without a scratch in a quick and efficient manner. You have to avoid obstacles like cones, puddles, pot holes, oil slicks? and... gates? Wait...

Speed and Precision

Your boss requires you to park these cars in record time. Every scratch, every dink, every bump is taken away from you. All while the owner looks on... Oh and those cones also come out of your paycheck I'm sure...

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Windows 10 or later
  • Processor: 2.0 Ghz+
  • Memory: 2 GB RAM
  • Graphics: Shader Model 2.0+
  • Storage: 200 MB available space

short_description: What if you could only do 2 things to park a car, move forward and go in reverse? And what if when you are reversing, your car turns left? Well no need to look any further! Valet Parking Not Included is the puzzle game made to frustrate you with these limits.
